attribution: Map images and pin data from Game8's Aniimo Interactive Map.

markers.name: The Argent Strait Chest 1
markers.desc: Placed out in an open field next to a chasm.

markers.name: Outpost
markers.desc: This research console is located in the first outpost that players will be able to access at early in the game.

markers.name: Freshsprout Hill
markers.desc: This Bloom is immediately available after teleporting to The Argent Strait early in the game.

markers.name: The Argent Strait Chest 2
markers.desc: Chest is on the main branches of a large tree.

markers.name: The Argent Strait Chest 3
markers.desc: Placed near a cliff facing towards the east.

markers.name: The Argent Strait Lumin Amber 6
markers.desc: This Lumin Amber floats above the air, surrounded by stones with singing Chirpi on them. Twine with a Chirpi to acquire the Lumin Amber.

markers.name: The Argent Strait Chest 4
markers.desc: Placed near a cliff facing towards the west.

markers.name: Island Landing
markers.desc: This Lumin Collection is placed on the eastern side of a small island where the Alpha Turbo spawns. Collect the Lumin energy within a time limit.

markers.name: Nimbus Fields Branch
markers.desc: This Branch is located next to Dr. Lewis near the Lumin Collection course.

markers.name: Nimbus Fields
markers.desc: This Bloom can be found by following the wind path on top of the Branch in The Argent Strait.

markers.name: Run, Emberpup!
markers.desc: This Lumin is spotted across the Bloom in Nimbus Fields. Collect all Lumin Energies within the given time limit.

markers.name: First Spark
markers.desc: First Spark is a Sanctum located southwest of the Alpha Turbo in Nimbus Fields. This is the first Sanctum that will be introduced to the game by following a family of Emberpups and a Flameruff after unlocking the Branch.

markers.name: Alpha Turbo
markers.desc: Alpha Turbo can be found ambling around the field, a little northeast of the First Spark Sanctum.

markers.name: Nimbus Fields Chest 1
markers.desc: This chest is located on top fo a dandeloin tree, next to a stone formation with an Aniipod on top. Hold on to the dandelions to reach the reach the chest.

markers.name: Nimbus Fields Chest 2
markers.desc: This chest is located on top of a debris across the dandelion tree. From the peak of the tree, reach the chest by flying down to it.

markers.name: The Argent Strait Chest 5
markers.desc: Found at the second floor of a collapsed ruin structure.

markers.name: Starry Flow
markers.desc: This Lumin Collection is located on a large tree root in a river in Mistwoods. Collect all Lumin Energies within the time limit.

markers.name: Mistwoods Lumin Amber 1
markers.desc: This Lumin Amber can be found surrounded by a group of Hummins. Defeat them to get the Lumin energy.

markers.name: Bloomville
markers.desc: This Bloom is located next to the bridge in Sea of Flowers.

markers.name: Village Vistas
markers.desc: This Lumin Collection is found on top of the tower beside the elder's house. Collect the Lumin energies within the time limit.

markers.name: Sea of Flowers Chest 1
markers.desc: This chest is found on top of the elder's house in Bloomville.

markers.name: Sea of Flowers Chest 2
markers.desc: This chest is found in front of a water wheel in a small lake in Bloomville.

markers.name: The Argent Strait Chest 6
markers.desc: Placed a top a stone arch with a wooden planks over it. There are flammable brambles beneath it.

markers.name: The Argent Strait Chest 7
markers.desc: Found underneath a stone floor, blocked by a couple of large rocks. Use an Aniimo skill to move the rocks out of the way of the chest.

markers.name: The Argent Strait Chest 8
markers.desc: Placed on a small ledge by the face of a cliff.

markers.name: The Argent Strait Chest 9
markers.desc: Found atop of some rocks, covered in brambles. Use fire from an Aniimo skill to remove the brambles.

markers.name: The Argent Strait Chest 10
markers.desc: Located near a cliff facing towards the east.

markers.name: The Argent Strait Chest 11
markers.desc: Placed near a ledge in the open, under the shade of larger trees up ahead.

markers.name: The Argent Strait Chest 12
markers.desc: Placed near a ledge in the open.

markers.name: The Argent Strait Chest 13
markers.desc: The chest is placed in the center of a ruin. It's protected by barrier that can be disabled after powering a nearby power node.

markers.name: The Argent Strait Chest 14
markers.desc: This Chest can be found East from the ruins under a rubble

markers.name: The Argent Strait Chest 15
markers.desc: This Chest can be found at the edge of the Cliff

markers.name: The Argent Strait Chest 16
markers.desc: This Chest can be found at the edge of the Cliff South to the beach

markers.name: The Argent Strait Chest 17
markers.desc: This Chest can be found North East side of the Beach hidden under the rubble

markers.name: The Argent Strait Chest 18
markers.desc: This Chest can be found at the South East edge of the beach surrounded by Chirpis

markers.name: The Argent Strait Chest 19
markers.desc: Placed on top of a stone pillar with brambles at its base that are flammable.

markers.name: The Argent Strait Chest 20
markers.desc: This chest is located near a cliff overlooking the Argent Strait bloom.

markers.name: The Argent Strait Lumin Amber 1
markers.desc: Emberpups and a Flameruff protect this Lumin Amber. Defeat or capture them to acquire the Lumin Amber.

markers.name: The Argent Strait Lumin Amber 2
markers.desc: This Lumin Amber is found under the shade of a tree.

markers.name: The Argent Strait Lumin Amber 3
markers.desc: This Lumin Amber is floating above a stone in the middle of the water.

markers.name: The Argent Strait Lumin Amber 4
markers.desc: This Lumin Amber is placed at a corner of a ruined wall.

markers.name: The Argent Strait Lumin Amber 5
markers.desc: This Lumin Amber is inside a cavern above water, with a mushroom below it.

markers.name: Rumbling Stones
markers.desc: This Lumin Collection is completed by running uphill while avoiding stones rolling down.

markers.name: The Argent Strait Morphling's Memory
markers.desc: This Morphling's Memory is located near the cliff to the west of The Argent Strait. Solve the memory by interacting with the Nimbi next to Emberpup on top of a dandelion stem.

markers.name: Zoe
markers.desc: Zoe can be found in a grassy field south of the Outpost in The Argent Strait.

markers.name: Theo
markers.desc: Theo is located along an intersecting path south of the Freshsprout Hill Bloom. He is accompanied by a Dewy.

markers.name: Venedel
markers.desc: Venedel is located along the shore directly west of the Alpha Tubster's location in The Argent Strait.

markers.name: Shion
markers.desc: Shion is found overlooking the sea in The Argent Strait from a cliff, south of the area's Bloom She is accompanied by a Bay Budclaw.

markers.name: Leola
markers.desc: Leola is found sitting next to a pillar by a huge tree located south of the Brighbough Plateau Bloom in The Argent Strait.

markers.name: Chirpi Songs Over the Fjord
markers.desc: This Lumin Marking is completed by lining up distant sea rocks by the water.

markers.name: Skippy
markers.desc: A group of Skippy can be found floating still while guarding a Lumin Amber on top of the rock formation between them.

markers.name: Nimbus Fields Chest 3
markers.desc: This chest is found near the wall of a cliff and a large root.

markers.name: Nimbus Fields Chest 4
markers.desc: This chest is found on a hill overlooking the crevice filled with water Aniimo.

markers.name: Nimbus Fields Chest 5
markers.desc: This chest is behind a wall of ice inside a small cavern. Use a Fire Aniimo to melt the ice to access the chest.

markers.name: Skippy
markers.desc: A Skippy can be found swimming around the river leading to the Forest of Falling Stars.

markers.name: Nimbus Fields Chest 6
markers.desc: This chest is floating in the air near an overgrown flower due to a Nimbi illusion. Break the illusion, and you'll find it on the pathway.

markers.name: Nimbus Fields Chest 7
markers.desc: This chest is floating above a small ruin due to a powerful gust from the fire below it. Twine with a Water Aniimo to extinguish the flame and bring it down, or fly to it with a flying or gliding Aniimo to open it.

markers.name: Nimbus Fields Chest 8
markers.desc: This chest is partly buried under sand. Twine with a Budclaw to dig it out.

markers.name: Nimbus Fields Chest 9
markers.desc: This chest is covered in brambles that can be removed by using fire from a Fire Aniimo.

markers.name: Nimbus Fields Chest 10
markers.desc: This chest in the middle of a Budclaw group buried in the ground. Capture and Twine with a Budclaw, use the Tunnel skill, then dig it out of the ground.

markers.name: Nimbus Fields Chest 11
markers.desc: This chest is a small cavern buried underneath stones. Use an Aniimo to break the stones to dig out the chest.

markers.name: Nimbus Fields Lumin Amber 1
markers.desc: This Lumin Amber is found by capturing a Blessed Budclaw in the open field.

markers.name: Nimbus Fields Lumin Amber 2
markers.desc: This Lumin Amber is floating above the water near a group of Skippy.

markers.name: Nimbus Fields Lumin Amber 3
markers.desc: This Lumin Amber is floating in the air over the water. Twine with an Animo that can fly or use the nearby dandelion to float to it.

markers.name: Race Towards the Yellow
markers.desc: This Lumin Collection is along the pathway on top of a small ruined structure.

markers.name: Crystal Cavern
markers.desc: Reach the end of the Crystal Cave until you reach an area with Pebblings and large orange crystals. Use an Aniimo with the Tunnel skill, like Shrubclaw, to enter the hole on the left. You'll find the Lumin Collection as you emerge on the other side.

markers.name: Core Descent
markers.desc: This Lumin Collection is on the pathway near the base of the hill where the Branch is.

markers.name: Gate of Ruins
markers.desc: This Lumin Marking is found by aligning your view of the pillar and the archway behind it.

markers.name: Barton
markers.desc: Barton is found playing with an Emberpup, a Celestis, and a Susuta by the road a little northeast of the First Spark Sanctum in Nimbus Fields.

markers.name: Alpha Geoclaw
markers.desc: Alpha Geoclaw can be found in a hidden underground area via the rivers of Nimbus Fields. At the spot full of Prankies and a Glacy, twine with Aniimo like Budclaw to use Tunnel into the cave's entrance.

markers.name: Forest of Falling Stars Chest 1
markers.desc: This chest is found on a small beach by some rocks.

markers.name: Forest of Falling Stars Chest 2
markers.desc: This chest is found on top of a boulder surrounded by ocean water, with brambles surrounding all sides. Use the nearby bouncy mushroom to fly in the air and glide your way to the chest.

markers.name: Forest of Falling Stars Chest 3
markers.desc: This chest is covered in brambles on the ceiling of a small ruin with a roof by the cliff. Use a Fire Aniimo to free the chest and have it drop down.

markers.name: Forest of Falling Stars Chest 4
markers.desc: This chest is on a small water stream, lying next to a fallen log.

markers.name: Forest of Falling Stars Chest 5
markers.desc: This chest is covered in brambles. Use a Fire Aniimo to burn away the brambles so you can approach the chest.

markers.name: Forest of Falling Stars Chest 6
markers.desc: The chest is partly buried under sand. Use or Twine with an Aniimo with a strong ability to unearth it from the sand.

markers.name: Forest of Falling Stars Chest 7
markers.desc: Inside a side cave within the Celestis Cave.

markers.name: Forest of Falling Stars Chest 8
markers.desc: Place three Starines in the nest and leave. When you return later, a chest will appear next to the nest.

markers.name: Forest of Falling Stars Chest 9
markers.desc: This chest is placed on top of a stone pillar overlooking the ocean.

markers.name: Forest of Falling Stars Chest 10
markers.desc: This chest appears after helping a Celestis gather their two other friends around the area. Stand in the middle of the stone circle as a Celestis, and the chest will spawn above you.

markers.name: Forest of Falling Stars Chest 11
markers.desc: This chest is buried under a pile of leaves, use or Twine with an Aniimo to remove the leaves and reveal the chest underneath.

markers.name: Forest of Falling Stars Chest 12
markers.desc: This chest is situated by a cliff face near the Alpha Stellarys.

markers.name: Forest of Falling Stars Chest 13
markers.desc: This chest is on top of a large tree, by one of its branches. Twine with an Aniimo to climb or fly to it.

markers.name: Forest of Falling Stars Chest 14
markers.desc: This chest is up in the tree's branches on top of a purple leaf. Twine with an Aniimo that can climb to reach it.

markers.name: Forest of Falling Stars Chest 15
markers.desc: This chest is surrounded by brambles in a small, deep, dark corner. You can use a Fire Aniimo to burn away the branches or glide in with a flying Aniimo to access the treasure.

markers.name: Forest of Falling Stars Chest 16
markers.desc: This chest spawns after offering three large Starines found in the area to trigger an event.

markers.name: Forest of Falling Stars Chest 17
markers.desc: Placed next to a rock by the beach.

markers.name: Forest of Falling Stars Chest 18
markers.desc: This chest is inside a hollow log behind a large Starine.

markers.name: Forest of Falling Stars Chest 19
markers.desc: The chest is by the base of a large tree.

markers.name: Forest of Falling Stars Chest 20
markers.desc: This chest is out in the open, surrounded by Pomeggs.

markers.name: Forest of Falling Stars Chest 21
markers.desc: This chest is up in the tree's branches on top of a purple leaf. Twine with an Aniimo that can climb to reach it.

markers.name: Forest of Falling Stars Chest 22
markers.desc: This chest is out in the open near a small cliff.

markers.name: Forest of Falling Stars Chest 23
markers.desc: This chest is up in the tree's branches on top of a purple leaf. Twine with an Aniimo that can climb to reach it.

markers.name: Forest of Falling Stars Chest 24
markers.desc: This chest is placed next to a couple of crates on the open field.

markers.name: Forest of Falling Stars Chest 25
markers.desc: This chest is in a bush next to a barrel and crate.

markers.name: Forest of Falling Stars Chest 26
markers.desc: This chest is placed before a cliff that overlooks the Forest of Falling Stars.

markers.name: Forest of Falling Stars Chest 27
markers.desc: This chest is on top of a boulder on a beach.

markers.name: Forest of Falling Stars Chest 28
markers.desc: This chest is underneath a collapsed stone wall. It will be placed before a cave entrance alongside a group of Chirpi.

markers.name: Forest of Falling Stars Chest 29
markers.desc: This chest is hidden in the center of a circle of Sunny Daisy flowers. Pick them all up, and the chest will appear.

markers.name: Forest of Falling Stars Chest 30
markers.desc: This chest is placed on top of a pillar-like boulder covered in brambles. Use a Fire Aniimo to burn the brambles away to interact with the chest.

markers.name: Soaring Glide
markers.desc: Soaring Glide is a Sanctum located on a cliff northeast of the Forest of Falling Stars Bloom.

markers.name: Forest of Falling Stars Lumin Amber 1
markers.desc: This Lumin Amber is protected by a group of Celestis. Defeat or capture them to accquire the Lumin Amber.

markers.name: Forest of Falling Stars Lumin Amber 2
markers.desc: This Lumin Amber is floating high above the ground. Use flying Aniimo to get it.

markers.name: Forest of Falling Stars Lumin Amber 3
markers.desc: This Lumin Amber is located on a river stream surrounded by Pranky that need to be defeated to acquire it.

markers.name: Forest of Falling Stars Lumin Amber 4
markers.desc: This Lumin Amber is floating in the air, with crates underneath a stone arch on a beach.

markers.name: Across the Canyon
markers.desc: This Lumin Collection only appears after clearing the Sanctum: Soaring Glide.

markers.name: Amethyst Glide
markers.desc: Found on a platform atop tree branches. Twine with an Aniimo that can glide to collect Lumin energy within the time limit.

markers.name: Nest of Stars
markers.desc: Align the markings on the large hollowed-out log with your perspective to form the Lumin Marking.

markers.name: Alpha Stellarys
markers.desc: Alpha Stellarys can be found north of the Outpost in the center of a star-shaped grassland.

markers.name: Nox
markers.desc: Nox can be found standing in the shade of a tree by the stream that is found south of the Forest of Falling Stars Bloom.

markers.name: Sarah
markers.desc: Sarah is located in Beast Fang Ridge, directly east of the Forest of Falling Stars Bloom.

markers.name: Mario
markers.desc: Mario is spotted along the main road east of the Forest of Falling Stars Bloom, right next to a Dr. Glass Trial.

markers.name: Echoback Landing Chest 1
markers.desc: Placed by the ledge of a cliff overlooking the ocean.

markers.name: Echoback Landing Chest 2
markers.desc: Placed on top of a large boulder surrounded by Chirpi.

markers.name: Echoback Landing Chest 3
markers.desc: Placed on a small islet in the middle of the water.

markers.name: Echoback Landing Chest 4
markers.desc: Located on the side of a large stone, it's held up by spiky brambles above the water. Use an Aniimo to burn off the brambles and have the chest fall into the water.

markers.name: Echoback Landing Chest 5
markers.desc: Placed along the top of a rock near a rocky wall.

markers.name: Echoback Landing Chest 6
markers.desc: Placed on top of a rock.

markers.name: Echoback Landing Chest 7
markers.desc: Found along the shores at the sandy beach.

markers.name: Echoback Landing Chest 8
markers.desc: Found on top of a coral-like rock formation.

markers.name: Echoback Landing Chest 9
markers.desc: Placed on top of some rocks in a small islet.

markers.name: Echoback Landing Chest 10
markers.desc: Found underneath planks of wood by the water.

markers.name: Crystal Cave
markers.desc: This Bloom is located inside the underground Crystal Cave in Nimbus Fields.

markers.name: Dorothy
markers.desc: Dorothy can be found at the shore located south of the Echoback Landing Bloom, near the Nurture area.

markers.name: Leah
markers.desc: Leah is located in a field found northeast of Beast Fang Ridge, near the Rising Flame Sanctum.

markers.name: Astrid
markers.desc: Astrid is found next to the shore on a grassy area, east of the Echoback Landing Bloom.

markers.name: Rushing Rapids
markers.desc: Rushing Rapids is a Sanctum located in an islet found north of the Alpha Panpanta in Echoback Landing.

markers.name: Alpha Panpanta
markers.desc: Alpha Panpanta can be found north of Echoback Landing Bloom near a shore.

markers.name: Young Omega Sherro
markers.desc: Young Omega Sherro can be found northwest of Beachside Sandbars Bloom on another island.

markers.name: Echoback Landing Lumin Amber 1
markers.desc: Northeast of the Echoback Landing Bloom. Catch the Blessed Shelly to get the Lumin Amber.

markers.name: Echoback Landing Lumin Amber 2
markers.desc: Found on the islet northheast of Echoback Landing. Catch the Blessed Susata bouncing on the buig brown mushroom to get the Lumin Amber.

markers.name: Echoback
markers.desc: Found southwest of the Echoback Landing Bloom, near the painter.

markers.name: Pillar Puzzle
markers.desc: Line up the markings on the stone cave pillars to claim a Lumin Amber.

markers.name: Echoback Hop
markers.desc: The starting area is found near the big brown mushroom on top of the huge pink corals. Bounce off the mushrooms to collect

markers.name: Aquatic Jump
markers.desc: Found near the ocean water and small islets northeast of the Alpha Panpanta. Collect Lumin Energy across the waters within a time limit.

markers.name: Fragment Restoration
markers.desc: There are markings on a large stone and the stone wall towards the east. Burn the wooden boxes, then line the markings up in your perspective to receive a Lumin Amber.

markers.name: Rolling Shells
markers.desc: Northeast of the Echoback Landing Bloom.

markers.name: Echoback Landing RV Campsite
markers.desc: Located on an island to the west of Echoback Landing. From the Bloom on the beach, swin west until you reach the RVV Camp.

markers.name: Beast Fang Ridge Chest 1
markers.desc: Placed on a rocky surface near a tree.

markers.name: Beast Fang Ridge Chest 2
markers.desc: Found on the branches of a large tree.

markers.name: Beast Fang Ridge Chest 3
markers.desc: Placed on top of a stump placed above a large stone arch/bridge.

markers.name: Beast Fang Ridge Chest 4
markers.desc: Chest is entangled in several thorny brambles on top of a stone. Use a Fire Aniimo to burn the brambles away to get to the chest.

markers.name: Beast Fang Ridge Chest 5
markers.desc: The chest is encased in ice inside the ice cavern where the Alpha Glynsera is located. Use a Fire Aniimo to melt the ice and free the chest.

markers.name: Beast Fang Ridge Chest 6
markers.desc: The chest is entangled in vines over a large hole. Use a Fire Aniimo to free it from the vines, but it will fall down the hole below into the Alpha Glynsera's arena.

markers.name: Beast Fang Ridge Chest 7
markers.desc: The chest is placed near some shrubbery and a stone.

markers.name: Beast Fang Ridge Chest 8
markers.desc: The chest sits in the shade of a small tree. The location overlooks a large crater where the Frigid Waters Sanctum can be found.

markers.name: Beast Fang Ridge Chest 9
markers.desc: The chest sits on a ledge near the southeastern wall of a large crater where the Frigid Waters Sanctum is located,

markers.name: Beast Fang Ridge Chest 10
markers.desc: The chest sits inside the large crater where the Frigid Waters Sanctum is, it's located along the southeastern wall of the crater.

markers.name: Beast Fang Ridge Chest 11
markers.desc: The chest is placed on a patch of grass above a cave entrance.

markers.name: Beast Fang Ridge Chest 12
markers.desc: The cgest is placed on top of a large boulder shaped like a wolf-like Aniimo head.

markers.name: Beast Fang Ridge Chest 13
markers.desc: This chest placed on a patch of grass on top of a stony ledge.

markers.name: Beast Fang Ridge Chest 14
markers.desc: Located on top of a crashed flight vessel.

markers.name: Beast Fang Ridge Chest 15
markers.desc: Burn all three stones to reveal the chest.

markers.name: Beast Fang Ridge Chest 16
markers.desc: Placed under a pile of leaves, use an Aniimo with a skill that can Break to remove the leaves.

markers.name: Beast Fang Ridge Chest 17
markers.desc: Ignite the stone with fire using an Aniimo to spawn the chest next to it.

markers.name: Beast Fang Ridge Chest 18
markers.desc: Break down a wall of a ruin to unearth a chest.

markers.name: Beast Fang Ridge Chest 19
markers.desc: Unearth a chest behind a pile of rocks with explosive barrels by using an Aniimo skill that can Break.

markers.name: Beast Fang Ridge Chest 20
markers.desc: The chest is attached to a tree with spiky brambles. Burn down the brambles to drop the chest.

markers.name: Beast Fang Ridge Chest 21
markers.desc: Placed under a pile of leaves, use an Aniimo with a skill that can Break to remove the leaves.

markers.name: Beast Fang Ridge Chest 22
markers.desc: The chest is encased in ice in a small lake. Use Fire Aniimo to thaw out the chest.

markers.name: Beast Fang Ridge Chest 23
markers.desc: Up above where the chest will spawn, talk to an Emberpup nearby a round stone. The Emberpup will push it off the cliff and crumble upon impact down below, revealing a chest.

markers.name: Beast Fang Ridge Chest 24
markers.desc: The chest is underground protected by a force field. Use an Ice Aniimo to make ice platforms with the nearby white and use them as weights to press on three different floor buttons to open the force field.

markers.name: Beast Fang Ridge Chest 25
markers.desc: Chest is submerged in water.

markers.name: Beast Fang Ridge Chest 26
markers.desc: Chest on top of stone arch.

markers.name: Beast Fang Ridge Chest 27
markers.desc: Chest is burried underneath stones, use an Aniimo skill that can break the rocks to dig up the chest.

markers.name: Beast Fang Ridge Chest 28
markers.desc: Chest is on top of a ledge surrounded by three Azure Grasses.

markers.name: Beast Fang Ridge Chest 29
markers.desc: Chest is underneath a bush.

markers.name: Sub-Idyllian Ruins
markers.desc: This Bloom is located inside the underground Crystal Cave in Nimbus Fields.

markers.name: Frigid Waters
markers.desc: Frigid Waters is a Sanctum located in an underground area in Beast Fang Ridge, found north of the Alpha Glynsera.

markers.name: Rising Flame
markers.desc: Rising Flame is a Sanctum located east of the Alpha Scorchhowl in Beast Fang Ridge.

markers.name: Alpha Scorchhowl
markers.desc: Alpha Scorchhowl can be found east of Sanctum: Water to Ice in the center of a three-stone monolith.

markers.name: Alpha Glynsera
markers.desc: Alpha Glynsera can be found south of Sanctum: Water to Ice, below an ice cave blocked by flammable vines or solid ice.

markers.name: Alpha Minespine
markers.desc: Alpha Minespine can be found in the Crystal Cave in Beast Fang Ridge, where you can find the entrance west of the area's Bloom. Collect 120 Lumin Ambers and twine with an Aniimo like Budclaw to use Tunnel into the entrance.

markers.name: Beast Fang Ridge Lumin Collection 3
markers.desc: This Lumin Collection spawns after completing the Soaring Glide Sanctum. Twine with a flying Aniimo and collect the Lumin Amber energies in the air to get the Lumin Amber.

markers.name: Beast Fang Ridge Lumin Amber 1
markers.desc: Found on the southeast partt of the Beast Fang Ridge, on a cliff. Bring a Fire element Aniimo to burn the thorns and free the Lumin Amber.

markers.name: Beast Fang Ridge Lumin Amber 2
markers.desc: Found on the southeast partt of the Beast Fang Ridge, guarded by a forcefield. Defeat the Flutternym guarding the Lumin Amber to get it.

markers.name: Beast Fang Ridge Lumin Amber 3
markers.desc: Found on the southwest part of the Beast Fang Ridge above the ruins. Twine with a flying Aniimo to get it.

markers.name: Beast Fang Ridge Lumin Amber 4
markers.desc: Found on the northern part of the Beast Fang Ridge near a group of Emberpup led by a Flameruff. Twine with an Emberpup to join their patrol and get the Lumin Amber.

markers.name: Beast Fang Ridge Lumin Amber 5
markers.desc: Found north of the Beast Fang Ridge, guarded by a group of Bonesky and Fenrier. Defeat or catch them to get the Lumin Amber.

markers.name: Beast Fang Ridge Lumin Markings 1
markers.desc: Found on the northeastern part of the Beast Fang Ridge.

markers.name: Beast Fang Ridge Lumin Markings 2
markers.desc: Found north of the Beast Fang Ridge under a cavern. Melt the ice covering the Lumin Marking to reveal it.

markers.name: Beast Fang Ridge Lumin Collection 1
markers.desc: To the left of the Beast Fang Ridge Bloom, down the road. Complete the relay on time to get the Lumin Amber.

markers.name: Nightwolf
markers.desc: Nightwolf is spotted east of Beast Fang Ridge, near the border to Mistwoods.

markers.name: Suu
markers.desc: Suu is right next to the Beast Fang Ridge Bloom, to its left.

markers.name: Talia
markers.desc: Talia can be found by the intersecting path going to the east that is found north of the Rising Flame Sanctum.

markers.name: Jilly
markers.desc: You can find Jilly at Beast Fang Ridge, southwest of the Beast Fang Ridge Bloom. You need to defeat Jilly in the first battle to unlock her Elite Pathfinder challenge.

markers.name: Mistwoods Chest 1
markers.desc: Found on a cliff above the cave on the northeast side of Mistwoods.

markers.name: Mistwoods Chest 2
markers.desc: Found at a spot with 4 rock circles at the northwest side of Mistwoods. To get the chest, tag the Hummin as it appears on each circle until it drops all its loot.

markers.name: Mistwoods Chest 3
markers.desc: Found on a small cliff near the pond on the western side of Mistwoods.

markers.name: Mistwoods Chest 4
markers.desc: Found on a cliff overlooking the pond on the western side of Mistwoods. Interact with the glowing flower to get the chest.

markers.name: Mistwoods Chest 5
markers.desc: Found on a rock in the pond at the western side of Mistwoods.

markers.name: Mistwoods Chest 6
markers.desc: Found on a platform in the middle of a river near the middle of Mistwoods. Twine with a Hummin and talk to the odd-looking Hummin to get the chest.

markers.name: Mistwoods Chest 7
markers.desc: Found buried in a pile of leaves on the northern side of Mistwoods.

markers.name: Mistwoods Chest 8
markers.desc: Found to the right of the Mistwoods Bloom.

markers.name: Mistwoods Chest 9
markers.desc: Found on the southwest side of Mistwoods. Twine with a Hummin to talk with the Pecuiliar Hummin eating the Red Caps. Keep looting the Red Caps until the Hummin runs out of them and it will give you the chest.

markers.name: Mistwoods Chest 10
markers.desc: Found in a tiny cave on the southern part of the Mistwoods. It will be guarded by a Flutternym.

markers.name: Mistwoods Chest 11
markers.desc: Found within the ruins on the eastern side of Mistwoods. Defeat the Peculiar Hummin to get it.

markers.name: Mistwoods Chest 12
markers.desc: Found on the bottom left corner of the ruins on the eastern side of Mistwoods.

markers.name: Mistwoods Chest 13
markers.desc: Found inside the temple on the eastern side of Mistwoods. From the hole on the roof, drop down and interact with the glowing flower to get the chest.

markers.name: Mistwoods Chest 14
markers.desc: Found on the roof of the temple on the eastern side of Mistwoods.

markers.name: Mistwoods Chest 15
markers.desc: Found inside a force field on a platform overlooking the lake on the southwest side of Mistwoods. Free the box under the platform by burning the vines so that the box hits the button underneath. This will free the chest.

markers.name: Mistwoods Chest 16
markers.desc: Found on the top center of the lake on the southwest side of Mistwoods.

markers.name: Mistwoods Chest 17
markers.desc: Found on a cliff overlooking the lake on the southwest side of Mistwoods.

markers.name: Mistwoods Chest 18
markers.desc: Found on a small cliff next to some collapsed ruins on the southern part of Mistwoods.

markers.name: Mistwoods Chest 19
markers.desc: Found under a wooden platform on the lake on the southwest part of Mistwoods.

markers.name: Mistwoods RV Campsite 1
markers.desc: Found on the southern part of Mistwoods. From the Bloom in Driftwise Meadow, travel southwest and follow the road into the yellow woods.

markers.name: Twisted Roots
markers.desc: The Twisted Roots Sanctum is located in an underground area in Mistwoods. Follow the Binding Oath side quest to unlock it.

markers.name: Burning Brambles
markers.desc: The Burning Brambles is along the road going to Bloomville found south of Mistwoods. Teleport to the RV Park: Nimbus Fields in Mistwoods then head south to reach the Sanctum easily.

markers.name: Alpha Leafy
markers.desc: Alpha Leafy can be found northeast of Breezy Plains Branch in the center of a grove.

markers.name: Omega Tuckin
markers.desc: Omega Tuckin can be found north of Mistwoods Bloom, burrowed near a large tree.

markers.name: Mistwoods Lumin Amber 2
markers.desc: Found on the northern part of the Mistwoods. Catch the Blessed Hummin to get the Lumin Amber.

markers.name: Mistwoods Lumin Amber 3
markers.desc: Near the center of the Mistwoods, under a fallen wall. Break the brick wall down to get the Lumin Amber.

markers.name: Mistwoods Lumin Amber 4
markers.desc: Near trhe southwest part of the Mistwoods on top of a tree stump.

markers.name: Mistwoods Lumin Amber 5
markers.desc: Near the southwest part of the Mistwoods hidden in a pile of fallen leaves. Hit the pile of fallen leaves to get the Lumin Amber.

markers.name: Mistwoods Lumin Amber 6
markers.desc: Found on the southwest part of the Mistwoods, on top of a wooden plank. Jump off the top of the cliff and land on the wooden platform to get the Lumin Amber

markers.name: Mistwoods Lumin Amber 7
markers.desc: Found on the southwest part of the Mistwoods. Defeat the Flutternym guarding the Lumin Amber to get it.

markers.name: Mistwoods Lumin Amber 8
markers.desc: This Lumin Amber is protected by three Budclaws, defeat or capture them to collect the Amber.

markers.name: Into the Mist
markers.desc: Found on the southwest part of the Mistwoods on top of a small pillar surrounded by thorns. Burn the thorns and complete the relay to get the Lumin Amber.

markers.name: Float Down
markers.desc: Found around the southwest part of the Mistwoods. Use a flying Aniimo to follow the trail of the Lumin Amber and get it.

markers.name: Shaded Stone
markers.desc: Found on the southwest part of the Mistwoods, on the rocks in front of a large tree. Break the rocks blocking the portion of the Lumin Marking to complete it.

markers.name: Blitzwood Chest 1
markers.desc: Placed on top of some wood, surrounded by brambles that can be burned off with fire from an Aniimo skill.

markers.name: Blitzwood Chest 2
markers.desc: The chest is wedged underneath a large metal cube that can conduct electricity.

markers.name: Blitzwood Chest 3
markers.desc: Near the ledge of a cliff, placed next to a plant with large leaves.

markers.name: Blitzwood Chest 4
markers.desc: Stuck on top of a tree while surrounded by several flammable brambles. Use fire from an Aniimo skill to burn them off to make the chest openable.

markers.name: Blitzwood Chest 5
markers.desc: Placed on top of a stone platform. The chest is protected by a barrier when first encountered and is disabled after defeating the nearby Iris defending it.

markers.name: Blitzwood Chest 6
markers.desc: Found underneath a cliff next to the Woods Glide Lumin Collection.

markers.name: Blitzwood Chest 7
markers.desc: Found on the rooftop of a ruined building.

markers.name: Blitzwood Chest 8
markers.desc: Placed in a small cliff area surrounded with trees.

markers.name: Blitzwood Chest 9
markers.desc: Found on the rooftop of a ruined building with an electric mechanism nearby.

markers.name: Blitzwood Chest 10
markers.desc: On a ledge inside a pit.

markers.name: Blitzwood Chest 11
markers.desc: At the end of a cave, behind a wall of stones that can be broken down with an Aniimo skill. The chest is found next to a cliff facing the ocean.

markers.name: Blitzwood Chest 12
markers.desc: Placed inside a crate next to a pack of Hummins.

markers.name: Blitzwood Chest 13
markers.desc: Buried under a pile of rocks which can be cleared by using an Aniimo skill to break them down.

markers.name: Blitzwood Chest 14
markers.desc: Found next to a rock.

markers.name: Blitzwood Chest 15
markers.desc: Nearby a ledge that overlooks the Sea of Flowers region.

markers.name: Blitzwood Chest 16
markers.desc: In a small open area near the cliffs that border towards the Sea of Flowers.

markers.name: Blitzwood Chest 17
markers.desc: Next to a pile of stones.

markers.name: Electric Flow
markers.desc: Electric Flow is located northeast of the Alpha Blazen in Blitzwood.

markers.name: Luz
markers.desc: Luz is found along the main road directly west of the Blitzwood Bloom.

markers.name: Phil
markers.desc: Phil is located east of the Blitzwood Bloom along the main road, right across a ruined area.

markers.name: Liuguang
markers.desc: Liuguang is located southeast of Blitzwood's Nurture along the road. He can be found sitting on the field.

markers.name: Alpha Blazen
markers.desc: Alpha Blazen can be found south of Blitzwood Bloom on top of a mountain.

markers.name: Cliff Mark
markers.desc: Found near the center of Blitzwood on a cliff and a rock. Match the pattern on the cliff and the nearby rock to get the Lumin Amber.

markers.name: Cliff Vista
markers.desc: Found on the western part of Blitzwood on the side of a cliff. You must use the giant fan on the ground to fly and complete the Lumin Marking. Go back in the air to get the Lumin Amber.

markers.name: Into the Sea of Flowers
markers.desc: Found on the eastern side of Blitzwood on a cliff. Use a flying Aniimo and follow the fleeing Lumin Amber before the time runs out.

markers.name: Pillar Jump
markers.desc: Found north of the Blitzwood Bloom on a set of pillars. Fly or jump from one pillar to the next and grab the items that appear. This spawns a chest that, when opened, rewards items and unlocks the Lumin Collection, where you must collect the Lumin Ambers on each pillar to complete it.

markers.name: Woods Glide
markers.desc: Found southwest of the Blitzwood Bloom on the side of the cliff. Fly and follow the cloud rings upwards to catch the fleeing Lumin Amber.

markers.name: Blitzwood Lumin Amber 1
markers.desc: Found near the Blitzwood Bloom above a crate on the road. Climb on the crate and fly up to get the Lumin Amber.

markers.name: Blitzwood Lumin Amber 2
markers.desc: Found on the southern part of Blitzwood inside a dead tree.

markers.name: Blitzwood Lumin Amber 3
markers.desc: Found on the southern part of Blitzwood inside a cave. Catch the Blessed Bolty to get the Lumin Amber.

markers.name: Tideblossom Coast Chest 1
markers.desc: Found along the beach shore on the western side of Tideblossom Coast.

markers.name: Tideblossom Coast Chest 2
markers.desc: Found on a small cliff on the southwest side of Tideblossom Coast.

markers.name: Tideblossom Coast Chest 3
markers.desc: Placed in a patch of grass with a few Budclaws nearby.

markers.name: Tideblossom Coast Chest 4
markers.desc: Placed on a small spot of sand surrounded by water.

markers.name: Tideblossom Coast Chest 5
markers.desc: Inside a cavern to the side of the small island's cliff.

markers.name: Tideblossom Coast Chest 6
markers.desc: Placed in a patch of grass on a rocky area.

markers.name: Tideblossom Coast Chest 7
markers.desc: Placed underneath rubble with an explosive barrel wedged between them.

markers.name: Tideblossom Coast Chest 8
markers.desc: Placed along the rocky slope of the island.

markers.name: Tideblossom Coast Chest 9
markers.desc: Placed near a ledge, on the eastern part of the island.

markers.name: Tideblossom Coast Chest 10
markers.desc: Place on a rocky surface at the northern part of the island.

markers.name: Tideblossom Coast Chest 11
markers.desc: Placed on a small spot of sand surrounded by water.

markers.name: Tideblossom Coast Chest 12
markers.desc: Placed on a smaller islet beside a rocky surface.

markers.name: Tideblossom Coast Chest 13
markers.desc: Placed around the shallow waters, the chest is partly buried underneath sand, so use an Aniimo skill to pull it out.

markers.name: Tideblossom Coast Chest 14
markers.desc: Placed on a tiny patch of sand surrounded by water.

markers.name: Tideblossom Coast Chest 15
markers.desc: Found on a cliff southwest of the Tideblossom Coast Bloom.

markers.name: Tideblossom Coast Chest 16
markers.desc: Found buried in a pile of sand south of the Tideblossom Coast Bloom. You must launch an attack at the sand to free the chest.

markers.name: Tideblossom Coast Chest 17
markers.desc: Placed a top of a large rock formation surrounded by Shrubclaw and Budclaws.

markers.name: Tideblossom Coast Chest 18
markers.desc: Placed at the foot of large rock formation, partly buried in sand. You can pull it out by using Aniimo skills that can break the sand.

markers.name: Alpha Luminelle
markers.desc: Alpha Luminelle can be found south of Tideblossom Coast Bloom. You will need to switch to nighttime and wait for the meteor to land into the arena.

markers.name: Tideblossom Coast Lumin Amber 1
markers.desc: The Lumin Amber floats above in the air by the cliffside of the island where the Alpha Luminelle spawns.

markers.name: Tideblossom Coast Lumin Amber 2
markers.desc: Several Budclaws protect this Lumin Amber. This only appears during the day.

markers.name: Tideblossom Coast Lumin Amber 3
markers.desc: Find and capture a Blessed Bulby to reveal the Lumin Amber in this area.

markers.name: Cecelia
markers.desc: You can find Cecelia at Tideblossom Coast, directly south of the Tideblossom Coast Bloom. You need to defeat Cecelia in the first battle to unlock her Elite Pathfinder challenge.

markers.name: Lionel
markers.desc: Lionel can be found east of the Tideblossom Coast Bloom, next to a group of Mudflat Budclaws and Mudflat Shrubclaw guarding a chest. He is accompanied by an Erlath and Fragrancier.

markers.name: Hathaway
markers.desc: Hathaway can be spotted along the stream north of the Tideblossom Coast Bloom. She is accompanied by a Flowerfield Glacy.

markers.name: Sea of Flowers Chest 3
markers.desc: This chest is inside the elder's house at the second floor.

markers.name: Sea of Flowers Chest 4
markers.desc: This chest is behind a couple of wooden crates underneath a small wooden roof.

markers.name: Sea of Flowers Chest 5
markers.desc: This chest is found behind two wooden crates.

markers.name: Sea of Flowers Chest 6
markers.desc: This chest is found on a small wooden cart at the back of a house.

markers.name: Sea of Flowers Chest 7
markers.desc: This chest is placed on top of a roof.

markers.name: Sea of Flowers Chest 8
markers.desc: The chest spawns in this spot after completing the Main Quest.

markers.name: Sea of Flowers Chest 9
markers.desc: Found sequestered in a corner at the bottom of the cave path.

markers.name: Sea of Flowers Chest 10
markers.desc: This chest is placed inside a large shrubbery surrounded by Budsquire and a Thornblade.

markers.name: Sea of Flowers Chest 11
markers.desc: This chest is dangling on a chain attached to a dismantled windmill. Burn the brambles on it to make it start spinning again and make it easily reachable.

markers.name: Sea of Flowers Chest 12
markers.desc: This chest is surrounded and covered in brambles. Use a Fire Aniimo to burn the brambles to access the chest.

markers.name: Sea of Flowers Chest 13
markers.desc: This chest is buried in leaves. Use an Aniimo to clear the leaves.

markers.name: Sea of Flowers Lumin Amber 1
markers.desc: This Lumin Amber is on top of a big rock next to a tree.

markers.name: Sea of Flowers Lumin Amber 2
markers.desc: A Blessed Budsquire appears during thunderstorm weather in the broken windmill, west of the Sea of Flowers Bloom. Capture it to get the Lumin Amber.

markers.name: Sea of Flowers Lumin Amber 3
markers.desc: This Lumin Amber is collected during the main story. Twine with an Iris and stand in the center of a circle of Iris for it to appear.

markers.name: Wally
markers.desc: You can find Wally in the Sea of Flowers, near Bloomville. He is located by the roadside east of the Bloomville fast travel point. You need to defeat Wally during the Promotion: Dewdrop Crystal's Resonance quest first to unlock his Elite Pathfinder challenge.

markers.name: Aurel
markers.desc: Aurel is located at the outskirts of Sea of Flowers to the east, just west of the Bloomville Bloom. She is accompanied by Hesper.

markers.name: Shura
markers.desc: Shura is located northeast of the Bloomville Bloom, right next to the town's central pillar. He is accompanied by a Fulmintis.

markers.name: Glimmer
markers.desc: Glimmer is located northeast of the Sea of Flowers Bloom, directly north of the Mayor's house. She is accompanied by a Prismana Fenmane, Prismana Pawney, Prisman Glacy, and a Prismana Glynsera.

markers.name: Candy
markers.desc: Candy is located directly east of the Blazing Wings Sanctum in Sea of Flowers. She is accompanied by a Gracewing.

markers.name: Aven
markers.desc: Aven is located at the intersection between Sea of Flowers, an RV Park, and Rosetower Woods. She is accompanied by a Leafy.

markers.name: Surfing in the Sea of Flowers
markers.desc: This Lumin Collection is next to the Blazing Wings Sanctum. Collect the Lumin energies within the time limit.

markers.name: Blazing Wings
markers.desc: Blazing WIngs is a Sanctum found north of the Sea of Flowers Bloom.

markers.name: Alpha Irisal
markers.desc: Alpha Irisal can be found south of Sea of Flowers Bloom.

markers.name: Driftwise Meadow Chest 1
markers.desc: Placed nearby a ledge next to a river, and before a patch of blue flowers.

markers.name: Driftwise Meadow Chest 2
markers.desc: Placed on a ledge near a river.

markers.name: Driftwise Meadow Chest 3
markers.desc: Placed in area where blue mist is scattered around.

markers.name: Driftwise Meadow Chest 4
markers.desc: Out in the open field where blue mist is scattered.

markers.name: Driftwise Meadow Chest 5
markers.desc: The chest is situated in a spot along the snowy mountain peak area.

markers.name: Driftwise Meadow Chest 6
markers.desc: Found at the foot of a waterfall near the snowy area.

markers.name: Driftwise Meadow Chest 7
markers.desc: At the top of a waterfall.

markers.name: Driftwise Meadow Chest 8
markers.desc: Found in the snowy area, placed between the trees.

markers.name: Driftwise Meadow Chest 9
markers.desc: Placed inside a large snowball, use fire from an Aniimo skill to melt the snow and free the chest.

markers.name: Driftwise Meadow Chest 10
markers.desc: Surrounded by brambles that need to be removed to access the chest. Use fire Aniimo skills to burn them.

markers.name: Driftwise Meadow Chest 11
markers.desc: Found at the highest peak of the tallest mountain of the Breezy Plains.

markers.name: Driftwise Meadow Chest 12
markers.desc: Placed near a ledge above a waterfall.

markers.name: Driftwise Meadow Chest 13
markers.desc: The chest is inside a large snowball by the lake. Use fire Aniimo skills to melt the snow to access the chest.

markers.name: Shuo
markers.desc: Shuo is located in the snowy mountains of Driftwise Meadow, just north of the lake next to the RV Park.

markers.name: Alice
markers.desc: Alice is located on an ice platform across a family of Snowfield Skippies and Snowfield Glacies in the lake found in Driftwise Meadow. She is spotted next to a weeping Bonesky.

markers.name: Brad
markers.desc: Brad is found next to the stream across the Driftwise Meadow Bloom to the north.

markers.name: Driftwise Meadow RV Campsite 1
markers.desc: From the Bloom of Driftwise Meadow, travel east through the snowy fields tp the central part of the area where you'll find the RV Camp.

markers.name: Driftwise Meadow Morphling's Memory
markers.desc: This Morphling's Memory is located next to a stream teeming with Fentufts. Interact with the crying Fentuft behind you to solve the puzzle.

markers.name: Berylline Vale Chest 1
markers.desc: Found on the branches of a giant tree next to the area where the Alpha Ignitis is located.

markers.name: Berylline Vale Chest 2
markers.desc: Placed on spikes atop a ruin. Use the Gravity Pull talent to pick up the chest and place it in a safer area.

markers.name: Berylline Vale Chest 3
markers.desc: Found inside one of the dirt domes. The entrance is blocked by brambles and vines, use a fire from an Aniimo skill to burn them away to clear the entrance.

markers.name: Berylline Vale Chest 4
markers.desc: Placed on a stony surface in the open alongside the path.

markers.name: Berylline Vale Chest 5
markers.desc: The chest buried under a pile of rocks that can be destroyed with an Aniimo skill.

markers.name: Berylline Vale Chest 6
markers.desc: Located underneath a log bridge over a small stream.

markers.name: Berylline Vale Chest 7
markers.desc: Found in an open field near a tree.

markers.name: Berylline Vale Chest 8
markers.desc: Found at the base of a tree.

markers.name: Berylline Vale Chest 9
markers.desc: Placed inside a dirt dome.

markers.name: Berylline Vale Chest 10
markers.desc: Placed on a rock at the open field.

markers.name: Berylline Vale Chest 11
markers.desc: Placed in the open on elevated ground.

markers.name: Berylline Vale Chest 12
markers.desc: Found inside a cave that is accessible via the Mistwoods, south of where the chest is located. The chest spawns after interacting with a plant.

markers.name: Berylline Vale Chest 13
markers.desc: Found inside a cave that is accessible via the Mistwoods, south of where the chest is located. The chest spawns after interacting with a plant.

markers.name: Berylline Vale Chest 14
markers.desc: Twine into a Wispitis, and challenge the youngest brother from a trio of Wispitis to a duel, and you'll be rewarded with a chest. They only appear during Nighttime.

markers.name: Berylline Vale Chest 15
markers.desc: Twine into a Wispitis, and challenge the second oldest brother from a trio of Wispitis to a duel, and you'll be rewarded with a chest. They only appear during Nighttime.

markers.name: Berylline Vale Chest 16
markers.desc: Twine into a Wispitis, and challenge the youngest brother from a family of Wispitis who is an Ignitis to a duel, and you'll be rewarded with a chest. They only appear during Nighttime.

markers.name: Berylline Vale Chest 17
markers.desc: Found inside a cave accessible via the Mistwoods, south of the chest's area, placed on a slope.

markers.name: Berylline Vale Chest 18
markers.desc: Found atop a ruin inside a cave accessible via the Mistwoods, south of the chest's area.

markers.name: Berylline Vale Chest 19
markers.desc: Found inside a cave accessible via the Mistwoods, south of the chest's area.

markers.name: Berylline Vale Chest 20
markers.desc: Twine as an Ignitis and speak to the Weak Wispitis and chest will spawn next to it.

markers.name: Berylline Vale Chest 21
markers.desc: Placed next to a small creek.

markers.name: Berylline Vale Chest 22
markers.desc: Found in front of a cave entrance in an area borderiog between Berylline Vale and the Mistwoods.

markers.name: Berylline Vale Lumin Amber 1
markers.desc: Found above a group of mud balls on the northern part of Berylline Vale. To get this Lumin Amber, twine with a Baleetle and place the mud ball in the open hole in the mud ball formation.

markers.name: Berylline Vale Lumin Amber 2
markers.desc: Found on top of rock formations, southwest of the Mudstone Pass Bloom. Smash the rocks to get the Lumin Amber.

markers.name: Berylline Vale Lumin Amber 3
markers.desc: Found above a stream on the southern part of Berylline Vale. To get this Lumin Amber, twine with a Budclaw and climb up to the cliff and dive into the circle of Budclaw on the stream.

markers.name: Berylline Vale Lumin Amber 4
markers.desc: Found on top of a rock in the middle of Berylline Vale. Climb up the rock and burn the thorns trapping the Lumin Amber to get it.

markers.name: Berylline Vale Lumin Amber 6
markers.desc: Capture the Blessed Wisptis roaming around to get the Lumin Amber.

markers.name: Berylline Vale Lumin Amber 7
markers.desc: Go inside the cave entrance northeast from the Mistwoods Bloom. Capture the Blessed Wisptis at the end of the cave to get the Lumin Amber.

markers.name: Ash
markers.desc: Ash is located along the road that is found directly west of the Berylline Vale Nurture.

markers.name: Keane
markers.desc: Keane is located in an intersecting road west of the Lightning Gale Sanctum. He is accompanied by a Geodeback.

markers.name: Loulla
markers.desc: You can find Loulla in the western area of the Berylline Vale Bloom. You need to defeat Loulla during the Promotion: Stardust's Blessing quest first to unlock her Elite Pathfinder challenge.

markers.name: Lightning Gale
markers.desc: Lightning Gale is a Sanctum located north of the Berylline Vale's Nurture, directly west of the Rainbow Woods Bloom.

markers.name: Alpha Bouldus
markers.desc: Alpha Bouldus can be found northeast of Mudstone Pass Bloom on top of a small hill.

markers.name: Alpha Ignitis
markers.desc: Alpha Ignitis can be found southeast of Berylline Vale Bloom.

markers.name: Russet Highlands Chest 1
markers.desc: West of the Rainbow Woods Bloom.

markers.name: Russet Highlands Chest 2
markers.desc: Located in the open alongside the pathway.

markers.name: Russet Highlands Chest 3
markers.desc: Northeast of the Rainbow Woods Bloom, on top of a small cliff.

markers.name: Russet Highlands Chest 4
markers.desc: Rescue a Helmet surrounded by spiky brambles by using fire from an Aniimo skill to burn them away so they can reunite with their friend. You'll receive a chest as a reward.

markers.name: Russet Highlands Chest 5
markers.desc: Found at the ruins east of the woods. Twine with Helmut and use its vision to direct the ball through the course in the ruins. Completing the course will unlock the gate blocking the chest.

markers.name: Russet Highlands Chest 6
markers.desc: Found on the west side of the woods on a cliff, buried under rocks. Break the rocks to get the chest

markers.name: Russet Highlands Chest 7
markers.desc: Help Helmut reunite with their friend by moving and placing large cubes with the Gravity Pull talent around to form bridges for them to cross.

markers.name: Russet Highlands Chest 8
markers.desc: Found inside an obscured room inside a ruin. You can twine with a smaller Aniimo to fit yourself through the hole, where you can peek at the chest's location to get to it.

markers.name: Russet Highlands Chest 9
markers.desc: Found off the side of the road on the southwest part of Russet Highlands.

markers.name: Russet Highlands Chest 10
markers.desc: Save the Helmut surrounded by Jawlings and you will be rewarded with a chest.

markers.name: Russet Highlands Chest 11
markers.desc: Use an Aniimo with the Bilateral Aniimo skill to line up symbols on the large rock to get a chest.

markers.name: Russet Highlands Chest 12
markers.desc: The chest appears here after saving a Helmut from a Helgon.

markers.name: Russet Highlands Chest 13
markers.desc: Found on the western side of Russet Highlands surrounded by a group of Jawling. During nighttime, twine with a Jawling and offer to protect the chest while the others sleep, then open the chest.

markers.name: Russet Highlands Chest 14
markers.desc: Found in the mountain in the middle of Russet Highlands.

markers.name: Russet Highlands Chest 15
markers.desc: Found on a mountain at the center of Russet Highlands.

markers.name: Russet Highlands Chest 16
markers.desc: Found south of the Twister Peaks Bloom on a mountain in the middle of Russet Highlands.

markers.name: Russet Highlands Chest 17
markers.desc: Found buried in a pile of leaves near the arena in the center of Russet Highlands.

markers.name: Russet Highlands Chest 18
markers.desc: Found west of the fast travel point of Russet Highlands nearby.

markers.name: Russet Highlands Chest 19
markers.desc: Found buried in a pile of leaves by a waterfall on the northern part of Russet Highlands.

markers.name: Russet Highlands Chest 20
markers.desc: Placed atop a rock formation.

markers.name: Russet Highlands Chest 21
markers.desc: Found off the side of the road on the northern part of Russet Highlands. It will be buried under a pile of leaves, knock them away to get the chest.

markers.name: Russet Highlands Chest 22
markers.desc: Help a nearby Helmut save their friend who's stuck in the middle of the water by using the Gravity Pull talent to form a bridge to land with the nearby wooden planks.

markers.name: Russet Highlands Chest 23
markers.desc: Placed atop of a rock formation with a flat surface.

markers.name: Russet Highlands Chest 24
markers.desc: Found underground inside a ruin. It's hidden behind a cavern obscured by a large stone that requires the Bilatral Aniimo skill to remove it by lining up markings on the stone.

markers.name: Russet Highlands Chest 25
markers.desc: Found underground inside a ruin. It's hidden behind a cavern obscured a pile of rocks that can be destroyed with an Aniimo Break skill.

markers.name: Russet Highlands Chest 26
markers.desc: Place underneath a grate that can be opened up by using Gravity Pull to position two stone balls hidden behind a wooden panel in front of it to activate two pressure plates on the left and right.

markers.name: Russet Highlands Chest 27
markers.desc: Found on top of a rock tower on the northern part of Russet Highlands. Defeat the Helmwhelp guarding the chest to get it.

markers.name: Russet Highlands Chest 28
markers.desc: Found on top of a rock tower on the northwest side of Russet Highlands. Twine with a flying aniimo and use the nearby wind current to launch yourself high and fly to the chest.

markers.name: Russet Highlands Chest 29
markers.desc: Found on the mountain on the northern part of Russet Highlands.

markers.name: Petal Shores

markers.name: Driftwise Meadow Lumin Amber 1
markers.desc: The Lumin Amber floats above in the air. Below it is a patch of flowers that you can hit with Electric attacks and skills to turn it into a trampoline.

markers.name: Driftwise Meadow Lumin Amber 2
markers.desc: Use an Ice-type skill at the nearby water to create an ice platform for Skippy to jump on; this will let you acquire the Lumin Amber.

markers.name: Driftwise Meadow Lumin Amber 3
markers.desc: The Lumin Amber is located inside a snowball in a cave up in the mountains. Use a Fire skill to melt the snowball and acquire the Lumen Amber.

markers.name: Springy Tuftball
markers.desc: Follow the path of Lumin energy and collect them all within a time limit. Some of the Lumin energy will be on tuftballs that you can spring on.

markers.name: Dr. Glass's Trial - Celestis
markers.desc: Find Dr. Glass under the purple tree in the Forest of Falling Stars. Twine with a Celestis and speak with Dr. Glass to begin the challenge. Eat 8 star-shaped fruits faster than the other Celestis to win.

markers.name: Dr. Glass's Trial - Bolty
markers.desc: This trial requires you to twine with a Bolty. Use its High Jump skill to dodge the falling columns and reach the high platform to complete the trial.

markers.name: Dr. Glass's Trial - Shelly
markers.desc: This trial requires you to twine with a Shelly. Use Shelly's Dash skill to roll while passing through the bonfires to extinguish all 12 of them.

markers.name: Dr. Glass's Trial - Hummin
markers.desc: This trial requires you to twine with a Hummin. Hold Dash and aim at the blue fruits and use them to hit the Hummins.

markers.name: Dr. Glass's Trial - Rookey
markers.desc: This trial requires you to twine with a Rookey. You can find a Rookey behind you with a group of Helmuts while facing Dr. Glass. Complete the four courses as Rookey to clear the trial.

markers.name: Dr. Glass's Trial - Baleetle
markers.desc: This trial requires you to twine with a Baleetle or a Waleetle. Simply pass through the rings while collecting yellow Stamina bubbles during Hustle to maintain your high speed. Finishing this will also allow you to evolve any of your Baleetles into Waleetles.

markers.name: Dr. Glass's Trial - Susuta
markers.desc: This trial requires you to twine with a Susuta. Hit five rolling Shellys to complete the trial. Track their movements and predict where they'll go after bouncing off a wall, then intercept them with a basic attack.

markers.name: Dr. Glass's Trial - Budsquire
markers.desc: This trial requires you to twine with a Budsquire. Use its Thorny Defense skill to perfect counter the incoming attacks. It's recommended to gain distance from the enemies after perfect countering them to finish the cooldown of your skill and make it ready for the next attack.

markers.name: Shortcut to the Castle

markers.name: Gliding Training
markers.desc: Twine with a Cozite Aniimo and talk to the Hot-Blooded Cozite to start the Lumin Collection.  Collect the Lumin energies by using the gust of wind below within the time limit.

markers.name: Zephyrus Landbridge Lumin Amber 1
markers.desc: Go up to a balcony south of the Courageous Wit Sanctum and enter a small cavern with eggs. Knock on each of the eggs until a Blessed Cozite appears. Capture the Blessed Cozite to reveal the Lumin Amber.

markers.name: Zephyrus Landbridge Lumin Amber 2

markers.name: Zephyrus Landbridge Lumin Amber 3
markers.desc: Help an Adventurous Cozite northeast of the stone castle on a stone bridge by smashing stones down below to release a gust of wind. After releasing the wind, talk to them again and follow them to the top of the stone castle, and it will reward you with the Lumin Amber.

markers.name: Zephyrus Landbridge Lumin Amber 4
markers.desc: Twine as a Larvazar or Pebbling and soak in the hot springs alongside the other Larvazar and you'll be able to acquire the Lumin Amber.

markers.name: Zephyrus Landbridge Lumin Amber 5
markers.desc: Directly south of the Larvazar hot springs, this Lumin Amber is surrounded by magma rocks. Break through the rocks or get around them to reach the Lumin Amber.

markers.name: Zephyrus Landbridge Lumin Amber 6
markers.desc: Found in the second floor of the undersea cavern, defeat or capture the Pebbling and Larvazar surrounding a luminous stone, then feed the stone to a nearby Gluttonous Larvazar, and it will transform into a Blessed Larvazar. Capture it, and it will drop the Lumin Amber.
